author: FChecklist
body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'veridian-architecture-v2-ux-two-stage-amendment' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  ...DIAN_ARCHITECTURE_V2_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-25.yaml | 74 ++++++++++++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 69 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)
Evidence Recorded: This is a documentation-only amendment to VERIDIAN_ARCHITECTURE_V2_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-25.yaml (no application code touched, no .github/workflows/** paths), and its technical citations to the source architecture document check out exactly (line 79 Prompt Compiler Engine, line 144 Browser Execution Engine, and line 213-215 Stage 1 Input Acquisition text all match verbatim, and the diff honestly discloses that 'mode pill'/'option chain'/'chat input' are not literal document vocabulary). However, the diff also asserts that the Owner's own words -- including the specific phrases 'FOR END USER THE BROWSER IS THE ONLY WAY TO INTERACT WITH THE SYSTEM', 'dynamic mode pills + dynamic option chain', 'makes the complete machine language output of the end user prompt', and 'given to the SOFTWARE to execute' -- are 'quoted in full' in ai-os/OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED_2026-07-23.yaml under id veridian-architecture-v2-target-repo-anchor. I read that exact entry directly: it contains only a paraphrased summary ('Owner directly clarified 2026-07-25: the browser-native AI platform must MERGE with the existing system so END USERS interact with it through the browser as the ONLY interaction path, two-stage software-first execution...') written by a prior automated task, not a verbatim Owner quote, and none of the specific quoted phrases above appear there or anywhere else in the ai-os tree outside this diff itself. This is a false/unverifiable evidentiary citation for a product-shaping requirement that will drive real, costly downstream engineering (new UI components, and a new mandatory Gateway G05 AI call on every single end-user request rather than only as an escalation fallback) once phase_2/phase_5 auto-dispatch into compliance-tracker. Separately, mandating an AI-gateway call on every completed request is not reconciled against the system's own existing, verified 'software first, AI second, minimal credits only when needed' credit-spend governance principle (MASTER_INDEX.yaml, registries.credit_spend_governance) and its propose/report two-gate ledger for metered AI spend -- the amendment should either route this new mandatory-AI-call commitment through that gate or explain why it's exempt. Issues found: False/unverifiable citation: phase_2 scope text (and the phase_5 scope text separately) claims Owner quotes are 'quoted in full in ai-os/OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED_2026-07-23.yaml id veridian-architecture-v2-target-repo-anchor', but that entry contains only a paraphrase -- the specific phrases attributed to the Owner ('FOR END USER THE BROWSER IS THE ONLY WAY TO INTERACT WITH THE SYSTEM', 'dynamic mode pills + dynamic option chain', 'makes the complete machine language output of the end user prompt', 'given to the SOFTWARE to execute') do not appear in that file or anywhere else in the ai-os tree. Either add the actual verbatim quotes to a traceable record (e.g. append them to the OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED entry or a new decision entry) or stop citing a file as containing quotes it doesn't contain.; Unreconciled architecture/cost conflict: the amendment upgrades Gateway G05 from an escalation-only fallback (Tier-5, on browser-tier insufficiency) to a mandatory second AI pass on every request that completes the browser FIRST pass. This increases metered AI-call volume on every single end-user interaction and is not reconciled against the system's existing, real 'software first, AI second, minimal credits only when needed' governance principle and its propose/report credit ledger gate -- the diff should address whether this new mandatory-call pattern is subject to that gate before it becomes the basis for real phase_2/phase_5 implementation work.; This amendment governs auto-dispatch of real application-code phases (2-10) into the compliance-tracker repo via auto_phase_continuation.py; because the sourcing for its core UX/architecture requirement is unverifiable as cited, merging it as-is risks committing substantial future engineering effort to requirements that cannot be independently confirmed against any recorded source.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
